Careers at Appstle

Founded by an Apple-Siri Engineer, and a former BCG Consultant, Appstle is a B2B SaaS company in the e-commerce space.

Appstle uses revolutionary technology to build unique, tailored, and affordable applications or software solutions, that enable e-commerce stores to provide the best end-to-end experience to their customers or shoppers. Appstle is a Silicon Valley based and funded company.

Company Values

Appstle is a highly merit-based, equal opportunity employer that fosters and encourages passion for technology, innovation, and problem solving. We are a highly diverse team that cuts across age, location, race, and religion.

Having founded and led by a female CEO, Appstle is committed to gender diversity. We are proud to share that as on May 1, 2022, the Appstle team achieved a natural 50% male-female ratio.

Focus areas

Appstle is focused on the customer retention, loyalty, and wallet share spaces. Appstle Subscriptions and Appstle Memberships are its 2 core products available on Shopify and Shopify Plus.

Benefits of working with Appstle

Growth

Appstle is a new-age and hi-tech SaaS company that is in hyper-growth mode. Appstle products and solutions are have been consistently No. 1 in their categories, and revered for their performance and robustness. Being a part of Appstle will give you tremendous opportunity to grow your skillset and grow with the company

Nurturing work environment

Appstle is a team-orinted workplace, where the success of each member is highly valued and collectively worked towards. Being a part of Appstle will mean being a part of a high energy, passionate, hard-working, and highly respectful team

Compensation

Competitive. Above industry standards

Benefits

2 weeks Paid Time Off; Paid maternity/paternity leave
